title: Gear shifter for Claude 🤯 #chatgpt #openai #gemini
description:
Choosing an AI model usually involves a boring dropdown menu or a sterile settings page. But one developer decided to change that by building a fully functional, physical manual gear shifter to control Anthropic’s Claude models.

This hardware hack maps different gears to specific AI models based on the compute power required. Shifting into first gear activates the lightweight Claude Haiku for rapid-fire tasks. Moving up to second gear engages Claude Sonnet for standard workflows and coding, while shifting into fourth gear summons the heavy-hitting Claude Opus. There is even a fifth gear dedicated to Fable.
To make the setup even more immersive, the builder integrated a custom token usage meter designed to look like a classic car speedometer. Instead of tracking miles per hour, the dials and needles react in real-time to data consumption and API calls, giving a literal visual representation of "burning through tokens."

While a physical stick shift for software may seem like overkill, it highlights a growing trend in the developer community: making artificial intelligence more tactile, interactive, and fun. As AI becomes deeply embedded in our daily workflows, hardware hacks like this bridge the gap between digital code and the physical world in a uniquely satisfying way.

#ClaudeCode #ClaudeAI #Anthropic #VibeCoding #TechTrends
